title: Audit-PDF field-line label change (audit_report.typ:912) compile-verified in tests but label text unpinned
evidence:
audit_report.typ:912: `#field-line("Employer / business name", if app.employer_name == none { "" } else { app.employer_name })`. audit_report_test.gleam renders the template with `      employer_name: Some("Stripe Dublin"),` (maximal_snapshot, :128) and asserts only `      let assert Ok(pdf_bytes) = audit_report.generate(data, priv_dir())

recommended_fix: Accept as compile-verified, or add a cheap test reading audit_report.typ as text and asserting it contains the "Employer / business name" field-line.
